You are an experienced, pragmatic software engineering AI agent. Do not over-engineer a solution when a simple one is possible. Keep edits minimal. If you want an exception to ANY rule, you MUST stop and get permission first.

This repo is a complete Rust rewrite of the Coder backend, reproducing all backend features and route/behavior parity with `https://github.com/coder/coder`. Progress: 72/229 OSS routes (31%). `docs/parity-matrix.md` is the source of truth. `coder/` is the read-only Go reference submodule; run `git submodule update --init coder` if empty.

**NEVER modify any file under `coder/`** — it is read-only reference material  
**NEVER commit changes to `coder/`**  
Do not modify files under `coder/` — This is the vendored Go reference. Treat as read-only.  
Files under `coder/` are Go; Rust work goes in `crates/` and `apps/`.

Port routes:
1. Find the missing route in `docs/parity-matrix.md`
2. Read the Go handler in `coder/coderd/<file>.go`
3. Read the SDK models in `coder/codersdk/<file>.go`
4. Read the SQL queries in `coder/coderd/database/queries/<file>.sql`
5. Define Rust domain types / API models in `coder-core` or the appropriate feature crate
6. Port storage access and migrations into `coder-db`
7. Port the HTTP handler into `coder-server` (or the appropriate feature crate)
8. Add tests in `#[cfg(test)]` modules alongside the code
9. Run validation: `cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets && cargo test`

Go references: handlers `coder/coderd/*.go`; models `coder/codersdk/*.go`; queries `coder/coderd/database/queries/*.sql`; database models `coder/coderd/database/*.go`; migrations `coder/coderd/database/migrations/`.

Rust: edition 2024, MSRV 1.85, toolchain 1.94.0; Axum 0.8; PostgreSQL/sqlx 0.8; Tokio; serde/serde_json; custom API-key/session/PBKDF2 auth; tracing; reqwest/rustls; AGPL-3.0-only.

Crates: `coder-core` shared types; `coder-server` Axum routes; `coder-db` SQL/migrations; `coder-auth`; `coder-identity`; `coder-rbac`; `coder-audit`; `coder-workspaces`; `coder-provisioner`; `coder-connectivity`; `coder-notifications`; `apps/coderd`; `coder-parity`. `crates/coder-server/src/app.rs` contains routes/handlers; also see `error.rs`, `coder-db/src/store.rs`, `coder-core/src/ports.rs`, `coder-core/src/api.rs`, `coder-core/src/config.rs`, `apps/coderd/src/main.rs`, `docs/backend-rewrite.md`.

Commands:
`cargo run --bin coderd`
`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`
`cargo fmt --all`
`cargo fmt --all -- --check`
`cargo run -p coder-parity -- inventory --go-root coder --rust-root . --scope oss --output docs/parity-matrix.md`
`cargo test -p coder-server`
`cargo test`
`cargo build`

All dependencies are declared in the root `Cargo.toml` under `[workspace.dependencies]`. Crates reference them with `dep.workspace = true`. **Do not** add dependency versions in individual crate `Cargo.toml` files. **No per-crate dependency versions** — Always use `workspace = true` references.

Workspace rules: `unwrap_used = "deny"`, `expect_used = "deny"`, `panic = "deny"`, `todo = "deny"`, `dbg_macro = "deny"`, `unsafe_code = "forbid"`. `unreachable_pub = "warn"`; `unused_qualifications = "warn"`. Use `thiserror` for defining error enums. Propagate with `?`. Never use `.unwrap()` or `.expect()`. **No `.unwrap()` / `.expect()` / `panic!()` / `todo!()` / `dbg!()`** — The workspace denies these at the lint level. CI and `cargo clippy` will reject them. **No `unsafe` code** — Forbidden workspace-wide.

Tests live alongside source code in `#[cfg(test)]` modules. **Do not create separate `tests/` directories** — Use `#[cfg(test)]` in-file. Handlers follow existing extractor, JSON response, and error-mapping patterns.

Validation:
1. `cargo fmt --all` — Format all code.
2. `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` — Must pass with zero warnings.
3. `cargo test` — All tests must pass.
4. `cargo build` — Ensure clean compilation.

Commits: use `type: message` (`feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `docs`, `test`, `chore`); describe what changed and why; reference Go routes; update `apps/coder-parity` when adding routes.
